name: bidi2pdf
description: Skills for rendering web pages to PDF and screenshots with bidi2pdf: the CLI, recipes, diagnosing a wrong PDF, a shared remote Chrome, review screenshots and PDF specs.

interface.shortDescription: Web pages to PDF with Chrome
interface.longDescription: Teaches Codex to turn web pages and HTML into PDFs with bidi2pdf, an open-source Ruby gem and command-line tool that renders with headless Chrome over WebDriver BiDi. Six skills cover the whole job: rendering a URL or HTML file to PDF from the command line (waits, screen, dark and mobile views, tagged PDFs, stdin and stdout) and reading its JSON result and exit codes; writing a recipe for pages that need steps before printing and validating it without a browser; diagnosing a PDF that comes out blank, unstyled or wrongly paged; running a shared remote Chrome container and keeping its sessions in check; taking review screenshots at phone and desktop width in light and dark mode; and writing RSpec specs for generated PDFs. The skills run bidi2pdf in a shell, so they need the gem (Ruby 3.4 or later) and Chrome or Chromium, or bidi2pdf's Docker image.
defaultPrompt: Render https://example.com to a PDF with bidi2pdf and tell me how many pages it has.
My PDF from bidi2pdf comes out blank - find out why.
Take phone and desktop screenshots of my app's start page in light and dark mode.
